displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 single-stage furnace in IOG-2037B (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide): Ear
meaning: A2L relay fault: heating stops and only the fan runs while the furnace is in mitigation mode. The fault is on the furnace control board.
causes: A2L relay fault on the furnace control board
diySteps: Write down Ear before cycling power. The chart lists a power cycle only with the relay check, not as a stand-alone fix
Technician: investigate the A2L relay, cycle power, and replace the integrated control board if the fault remains
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Ear is a control-board relay fault in mitigation mode.
